x: Highlight of the year must be the 3rd placing in the Inter Ladies 200m Final in the Womens A.A.A. Championships by Jackie Harman. Jackie also placed 4th in the 100m Final and set club records in the Heats.

(July 30th and 31st) Two fine runs by Jackie Harman, who has recently joined us from Herne Hill, and these set new Club Records. Jackie finished 4th in the Inter Ladies 100m in 12.15 and won the bronze in the 200m in 24.31.

Everyone was a star but pride of place must go to Jackie Harman who gained the sprint double by a huge margin. This was Jackie's first League appearance for us and she could be a big factor in our promation chances.

An early guide to summer form was provided by Jackie Harman who won a SCWAAA open 60m at Crystal Palace on 27th Oct. 82 in 7.8 secs. Also in form was Wendy Dunsford who put the shot 10.38m at an Oxford Univ.

Jackie Harman's 11.81 100m was good enough for 5th place in the UK Intermediate women's lists (in fact 3 of the faster times were 11.8 windy hand timings, so in our book Jackie was good enough for second).

Jackie Harman won the Inter Girls 100m in 12.2 and the 400m in 60.1. Both Sharon and Jackie went on to repeat their wins in the London Schools Javelin and 200m while Gail improved her 1500m time to 5.16.1 but finished in 2nd place.
